- **Fresh angle — conditional matching burn commitments:** extend the pledge mechanic with a two-sided commitment: wallet A posts a matching challenge — "I'll burn 500k DUMB if the community burns 1M" or "match me 1:1 up to 1M DUMB" — as a signed message (no gas, no funds move, same pattern as the shipped pledge board). The matcher's commitment executes only when the matched condition is verified on-chain; both legs verified with the existing per-wallet voluntary-burn ledger (arrival-leg accounting, the same machinery that flips pledges to redeemed). The honest shape holds: NO custody (everyone burns straight to dead from their own wallet), NO new contract, NO prizes, NO promised returns — a commitment device, not a contest; matched commitments are labeled promises, never burns, until the burns land.
- **Freshness verified:** zero "matching pledge"/"conditional burn"/"burn match"/"match my burn"/"matched burn"/"if you burn" hits anywhere in this file — genuinely unevaluated. (The 13 "challenge" hits are all the parked "rug-or-real challenge" scanner quiz, a different mechanic.) Distinct from the shipped unconditional pledge board (single-party promises, no counterparty), the 22:03 parked crowdfunded deep scan (pooled payment for a product, fixed 100k bar), and the 17:23 parked burn-to-vote (votes, not burns). The coordination problem is real in principle: one person's burn is a rounding error, ten matching burns are a headline — matching challenges are how charity fundraisers and community drives actually work.
- **Verdict: PARKED, not vetoed, on four grounds:** (1) **Zero measured demand for the base mechanic** — the unconditional pledge board holds exactly one pledge (too_dumb, 1000 DUMB, unredeemed) and rally_open/rally_burn have never fired; a conditional layer on a base nobody uses is the standing supply-for-unmeasured-demand error this file keeps parking on. (2) **New durable state + adjudication semantics** — challenge keys, condition tracking, match-window expiry ("what if nobody matches — the burn is final but the match lapses"), partial-match rules (does 60% of the bar trigger a pro-rata match?), cancellation semantics for unmet challenges; "more code = more problems" for an unproven payoff. ## 2026-10-03 11:43 — #8 bullish-demand research: "copy the burn" considered and PARKED (research-only, no ship)

- **Fresh angle — one-tap "mirror this burn" on the burn leaderboard:** each leaderboard row gets a "copy" action that pre-fills BurnBox with the same token + amount, collapsing the gap between seeing someone burn and doing it yourself. The social-mimicry thesis: recognition-only leaderboards inspire but never convert — "Amayah burned 50M" is a spectator fact until one tap makes it the reader's action. Every use IS a voluntary burn, so it clears the burn leg of the utility bar natively. Freshness verified before logging: zero "copy the burn"/"copyburn"/"mirror a burn"/"mirror the burn" hits anywhere in this file — genuinely unevaluated (the "mirror" hits are all code-pattern mirroring, unrelated); distinct from the shipped per-row share affordances (the sharer's own row, not someone else's), the 22:03 parked crowdfunded deep scan (pooled payment for a product, not copy-my-neighbor burning), and the 04:23 parked burn-day .ics (cadence, not conversion).
- **Verdict: PARKED, not vetoed, on three grounds — the safety one is the sharpest:** (1) **Anti-deliberation on an irreversible action.** Every burn surface on the hub is deliberately slow by design: acknowledgment checkbox, AlertDialog final-check, pre-burn math panel, receipt-verified success. The whole safety posture is "make the irreversible moment deliberate" (the 2026-09-28 "Before you sign" ship exists precisely for this). A one-tap mirror reverses that posture — it converts someone else's conviction into your impulse, and copying a whale's amount can nudge a small holder into burning an amount calibrated to someone else's stack, not theirs. The only safe shape (force the full acknowledgment + AlertDialog flow again) erases the feature's entire value proposition — a feature whose safe shape is "not this feature" does not earn a build. (2) **Zero dataset.** The leaderboard has zero voluntary-burner rows today (only the 100k scan-pass burns from tests, excluded from the leaderboard per the protocol-leg rule) — this would be UI for an empty table, the invented-activity smell the community-honesty rules exist to prevent. (3) **Thin increment.** It's a pre-fill on BurnBox, not a capability — the "inspiration" payload already ships via the leaderboard's recognition rows themselves. **Utility bar 1/3** — every use burns ✓, but real repeated pain ✗ (nobody asks to copy amounts; conviction is the pain, not amount selection) and outsiders-in ✗ (serves visitors already on /burn). **Four-lens:** better-marginal, safer-negative (deliberation friction exists on purpose), more-secure-neutral, fun-partial. **Not a veto** — no custody/signing involved, no guardrail violation, and the mechanic is honest (real rows, real amounts); it fails on safety direction and sequencing, not on principle. **Revisit gate:** a real voluntary-burner population on the leaderboard (rows exist to copy) AND a user ask for it via feedback/Telegram — then the shape is "pre-fill, still full guarded /burn flow," never one-tap; safe shape then = deliberation friction intact, no whale-amount nudge copy, never pre-checked acknowledgments. **Related angles probed and set aside without full writeups:** cross-community scan-offs (zero "scan-off" hits — but cross-community competition needs another community's participation = outreach = Antonio's lane, plus endorsement-laundering adjacency); generic token-literacy quiz (zero "token quiz" hits — the quiz family is evaluated twice already: chooser quiz REJECTED on advice grounds 01:13, rug-or-real challenge parked — a third quiz is churn); bridge-guide content (zero hits — the onramp-page family is already parked, this is the same shape); leaderboard seasons (zero hits — seasons need an audience; recognition-only seasons for ~zero burners = invented competition optics); rug registry / scam wall (zero hits — governed by the rug-autopsy park's naming/retaliation precedent, only heavier: a standing accusation surface).
